facts.fact: Starlink had applied to POTRAZ for authorisation to introduce satellite internet in Zimbabwe and, per Nehanda Radio on 22 July 2024, no authorisation is reported; POTRAZ revoked the exclusive Starlink rights said to have been given to IMC Communications and said licences are not technology-specific, so any licensed ISP may use Starlink.

note: Application pending as of article date; no licence or sale stated.
